MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick felt useful because I have a television and recently bought a DVD player; adding streaming would give that setup another practical use, even without needing 4K.",
    "The TV antenna felt relevant because local channels would add another way to watch television, provided reception works at my home."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The iPad case serves a familiar purpose, but my tablet is a Fire 7, so it would not fit the device I have.",
    "The USB-C hub has appealing memory-card slots, but I already have a card reader and have not shown a need for the hub's other connections.",
    "The gaming bundle, earbuds, meeting headset, smart speaker, and security cameras introduce activities I am not currently shopping for. Photography accessories do not imply that I want home surveillance."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in Alexa devices and gaming, although those features are not what I am looking for.",
    "My history of buying electronics accessories seems to have been treated as interest in almost any connected device, regardless of whether it solves a need for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact device compatibility matters: a useful accessory needs to fit my tablet, camera, or existing connections.",
    "I repeatedly choose practical items such as memory cards, cables, mounts, storage cases, and power strips; a clear job in my existing setup matters more than extra features.",
    "My most recent lens-cap purchase continues my photography-accessory interest, while my existing card reader makes another card-reading device less compelling without a new need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in useful television additions, but stretched my device history into unrelated gadgets and overlooked compatibility and needs I have already covered."
}
